comment: Character heights in grid pixels (figure top to feet). A character without 'height' gets 'default_height'; one with 'height' keeps it. All sources (*_clean.png) are drawn looking right; nothing is mirrored. Run tools/art/prepare-characters.ps1 after any change, then rebuild the scenes. Avatars (R10): add to a character "avatars": { "source": "<folder with <emotion>.png directly in it; subfolders are not read>", "facing": "right" or "left" (how the source is drawn) } and run tools/art/prepare-avatars.ps1, then Paramatrix > Collect Content. Avatars are pictures in Full HD screen pixels, all exactly 115x135 (the standard 229x270 card cut, halved); a placeholder is made with -Pad. Characters without avatars keep placeholders cut from the clean figures.

canvas.why: the walk frames (_img/Paranoik/walk.png cut by split-row.ps1): canvas 73x149, soles on the bottom row, head centre at column 34. The source is already on the grid and drawn by hand at 148: height 148 keeps it 1:1. The standing hero stands on the same floor row with the head centre at the same column, or he jumps when he starts walking
